description: Shared Renovate policy for Giskard-AI repositories. Extend it with "github>Giskard-AI/.github".

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security-fix PRs (GitHub alerts and OSV) must not wait for minimumReleaseAge. Renovate's built-in default already sets this; it is explicit here so the 7-day wait never holds back a fix.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Lock file maintenance has no release timestamp, so minimumReleaseAge would block it forever. Configure the release-age cooldown in the package manager instead (uv exclude-newer, pnpm minimumReleaseAge, npm min-release-age).

packageRules.description: Do not bump the Python interpreter version (requires-python, .python-version, python-version on actions/setup-python); projects change it on purpose.
One PR per package manager. Lock file maintenance keeps its own PR.
GHCR and Quay do not expose image release timestamps; without this, minimumReleaseAge would block every update of images hosted there.
